description: Show one place with all its attributes, votes, photo count and its link to the map. Use it when the user wants details about a place from find_nearby_places, such as opening hours or whether it is indoors.

id.description: The id of a place, from find_nearby_places.

name: get_place

attribution.description: Data attribution. Show it with the data.

credit.description: How the publisher asks to be credited, in its own language (e.g. "京都市オープンデータ"); its Japanese name where it asks for nothing else. Show it with the place.

publishers.description: Only the wards or cities that supply the places of this response (`publisher` on a place).

source.description: The value of `source` on its places.

title.description: Full name, e.g. "City of Kyoto public toilet list".

url.description: Where the dataset is published.

meters.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, not above sea level.

altitude.description: Measured by the device of whoever added the place, there; null if unknown.

author.description: Shown as "Discovered by @handle" next to the source.

handle.description: Username of whoever added the place; null if imported or anonymous.

confirmCount.description: Votes that the place still exists.

confirmVoteUntil.description: Until when the latest vote that the place still exists counts. Unix milliseconds; day only (12:00 Japan time). Absent without such a vote.

confirmation.description: Whether the Ippuku community has confirmed the place recently.

at.description: Day of the last entry, edit or confirmation in Ippuku (imports do not count).

bonusPoints.description: Points for confirming it while open.

mineAt.description: Own valid confirmation (exact time); null without sign-in.

open.description: No confirmation in the last 12 months.

until.description: Day until which the place counts as confirmed (at plus 12 months).

createdAt.description: Unix milliseconds; day only (12:00 Japan time).

dataset.description: The dataset the place comes from, with the name, credit and license to show with it; absent for osm and user.

credit.description: How the publisher asks to be credited, in its own language (e.g. "京都市オープンデータ"); its Japanese name where it asks for nothing else. Show it with the place.

publishers.description: Only the wards or cities that supply the places of this response (`publisher` on a place).

source.description: The value of `source` on its places.

title.description: Full name, e.g. "City of Kyoto public toilet list".

url.description: Where the dataset is published.

fieldOrigins.description: For imported places: where each field comes from, source (see source) or community (changed by Ippuku users). Keys: name, nameJa, position, attrs.<attribute>. null for places added by users.

i18n.description: Versions of the Japanese texts of an imported place in other languages, by language (en and ko): name, and from attrs operator, access and openingHours. English comes from OpenStreetMap (name:en) where it has one, otherwise it is machine-translated; Korean is always machine-translated. Only the languages and keys that have a version; absent if there is none. Show the version in the reader's language instead of the Japanese text (Korean readers: ko, else en), and keep the original visible.

myAnswers.description: Keys of the yes/no attributes the signed-in user has already answered at this place (a suggestion for that attribute, or "not sure"). Always empty without sign-in.

myVote.description: Always null without sign-in. An own confirmation older than 12 months is open again (null).

osm.description: The OpenStreetMap object, for places from OSM.

pendingPhotos.description: Own photos waiting for review; always empty without sign-in.

url.description: Needs the session; the preview is at url + "/preview".

author.description: Credit the photographer by this username when you show a photo under CC BY 4.0.

handle.description: Username of the photographer; null if anonymous.

createdAt.description: Unix milliseconds; day only (12:00 Japan time).

license.description: cc_by_4_0: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, credit the photographer (author.handle). none: a photo showing a stamp impression as its main subject; its design belongs to the station or operator, not to the photographer. Not under a free license, shown in Ippuku only; do not reuse it.

mine.description: Uploaded by the signed-in user; always false without sign-in.

url.description: Relative to https://api.ippuku.app. At most 1600 px on the longer side. A preview with 720 px on the shorter side (same aspect ratio) is at url + "/preview"; show it in lists and thumbnails.

publisher.description: Japanese local government code of the ward or city that published the place, where a dataset has several (tokyo_opendata). Its name is in the publishers of the dataset in GET /v1/regions; the license asks you to show it.

rejectCount.description: Votes that the place is gone.
